Organised by Tennis Australia and the first of the four majors each year, this tournament is played at which Melbourne venue?
The Australian Open is a tennis tournament organised by Tennis Australia annually at Melbourne Park in Melbourne, Victoria. It is the first of the four major tennis tournaments every year.
